tasks.prompt: Implement export function mergeIntervals(intervals) in src/merge.js. Input is an array of [start, end] number pairs, possibly unsorted and overlapping. Return a new array of merged, non-overlapping intervals sorted by start. Touching intervals (end of one equals start of the next) must merge. Empty input returns []. Do not modify test.mjs or package.json.

src/page.js exports paginate(items, page, pageSize). It is buggy. A page is 1-based. It must return { items, page, pageSize, total, totalPages } where items is the slice for that page, total is items.length, and totalPages is ceil(total/pageSize) or 0 when empty. Out-of-range pages return an empty items array but still the correct totals. pageSize < 1 or page < 1 should throw. Do not modify test.mjs or package.json.

Rename the class/export UserRepo to AccountRepo across the src/ directory. Update every import and constructor call. Public API in src/index.js must export AccountRepo. Do not modify test.mjs or package.json.

src/money.js formatCents(cents) must return a decimal string with exactly two fraction digits (150 → "1.50", 1 → "0.01", -20 → "-0.20"). src/contract.js is a frozen public contract — do not change that file. Do not modify test.mjs or package.json.

Implement export function parseSearch(qs) in src/query.js. qs is a query string without a leading '?'. Rules: plus becomes space; values are URL-decoded; a key with no value is ""; repeated keys become an array of values in order; a key that appears once stays a string; limit if present must be a finite integer (parse as number, not string); missing keys are omitted. Empty input returns {}. Do not modify test.mjs or package.json.

Implement export class TokenBucket in src/limiter.js. constructor({ capacity, refillPerSecond, now }). now() returns unix ms and defaults to Date.now if omitted. Methods: tryRemove(n=1) returns true if n tokens were available and consumed, else false and consumes nothing; available() returns current tokens capped at capacity. Tokens refill continuously from elapsed time. Start full. Do not modify test.mjs or package.json.
